name: claude-code-supernotifier
description: Native desktop notifications for Claude Code sessions: multi-window aware, click-to-focus (macOS), repo-aware templates. Works on macOS, Linux (notify-send) and Windows 10+.

scripts.package: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && node esbuild.js --production

claudeCodeSupernotifier.notifyOnStop.markdownDescription: Show a desktop notification when Claude Code finishes responding.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.notifyOnAttentio.markdownDescription: Show a desktop notification when Claude Code needs attention (permission prompts, idle prompts, questions).

claudeCodeSupernotifier.notifyOnSubagent.markdownDescription: Show a desktop notification when a Claude Code subagent (`Task`) finishes. Off by default to avoid noise during normal multi-step turns.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.suppressSubagent.markdownDescription: Suppress permission and question prompts that originate inside a `Task` subagent (events carrying an `agent_id`). On by default so nested approvals don't ping; top-level prompts are unaffected.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.minTaskDurationS.markdownDescription: Minimum task duration, in seconds, before a finished/attention notification fires. Tasks that complete faster than this are treated as noise and suppressed (`Stop`, `PermissionRequest`, and `AskUserQuestion` events). `0` (the default) disables the threshold; values are clamped to `0..3600`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.sound.markdownDescription: Global notification sound name, used as the fallback for every event. Leave empty for no sound. Examples: `Glass`, `Ping`, `Submarine`. macOS plays the named `UNNotificationSound`. On Windows the default toast sound is used (`Notification.Default`) and empty disables it. On Linux the name is mapped to a freedesktop theme sound (played via `paplay`/`aplay`), falling back to a bundled WAV when that theme is missing.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.stopSound.markdownDescription: Sound name for **Stop** (turn finished) notifications. Overrides `sound` when set; leave empty to use the global `sound`. Same per-platform behaviour as `sound`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.permissionSound.markdownDescription: Sound name for **permission** prompts (`PermissionRequest`). Overrides `sound` when set; leave empty to use the global `sound`. Same per-platform behaviour as `sound`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.questionSound.markdownDescription: Sound name for **question** prompts (`AskUserQuestion`). Overrides `sound` when set; leave empty to use the global `sound`. Same per-platform behaviour as `sound`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.subagentStopSoun.markdownDescription: Sound name for **subagent finished** notifications (`SubagentStop`, requires `notifyOnSubagentStop`). Overrides `sound` when set; leave empty to use the global `sound`. Same per-platform behaviour as `sound`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show a banner **and** play the sound.
Play the sound only — no banner.
Show the banner only — stay silent.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.stopLevel.markdownDescription: Notification level for **Stop** (turn finished) events. Supersedes `notifyOnStop`; when unset the legacy boolean still applies.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show a banner **and** play the sound.
Play the sound only — no banner.
Show the banner only — stay silent.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.permissionLevel.markdownDescription: Notification level for **permission** prompts (`PermissionRequest`). Supersedes `notifyOnAttention`; when unset the legacy boolean still applies.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show a banner **and** play the sound.
Play the sound only — no banner.
Show the banner only — stay silent.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.questionLevel.markdownDescription: Notification level for **question** prompts (`AskUserQuestion`). Supersedes `notifyOnAttention`; when unset the legacy boolean still applies.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show a banner **and** play the sound.
Play the sound only — no banner.
Show the banner only — stay silent.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.subagentStopLeve.markdownDescription: Notification level for **subagent finished** events (`SubagentStop`). Defaults to `off`; supersedes `notifyOnSubagentStop` when set.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.notifyCommand.markdownDescription: Optional override for the desktop-notifier binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (`notify-send` on Linux, `powershell` on Windows, bundled helper on macOS). On Linux you can point this at `dunstify` or another `notify-send`-compatible binary.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Respect your macOS notification preference (System Settings → Notifications → Claude Code SuperNotifier → **Banners** or **Alerts**) and also keep the notification in Notification Center until dismissed.
Always show as a transient banner that auto-dismisses. No Notification Center entry.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.notificationStyl.markdownDescription: Controls how notifications are presented. To make notifications **stay until clicked**, leave this as `system` and set the style to **Alerts** in macOS System Settings → Notifications → Claude Code SuperNotifier.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.titleTemplate.markdownDescription: Notification title template. See README for the full list of `${variables}`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.messageTemplate.markdownDescription: Notification body template. See README for the full list of `${variables}`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.includeBranch.markdownDescription: Include the current Git branch in the default notification message.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.allowedRepos.markdownDescription: Optional allow-list of repository folder names. Empty means all repositories.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.customRepoNames.markdownDescription: Optional mapping from folder name to display name shown in notifications.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.focusOnClick.markdownDescription: Open the matching Claude Code session when clicking the notification. macOS only — Linux and Windows notifications are fire-and-forget for now.

enumDescriptions: Open the Claude Code session that sent the notification.
Only bring the VSCode window to the front — no session, chat, or folder lookup.
claudeCodeSupernotifier.clickAction.markdownDescription: What clicking a notification does. `session` opens the matching Claude Code session; `window` only focuses the VSCode window. Requires `#claudeCodeSupernotifier.focusOnClick#`. macOS only.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.clearOnFocus.markdownDescription: Remove delivered notifications from Notification Center when you focus the VSCode window they belong to. macOS only.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.claudeOpenSessio.markdownDescription: VS Code command used to open a Claude Code session by session id.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.claudeFocusComma.markdownDescription: VS Code command executed after opening a Claude Code session to bring it into focus.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.stopLabel.markdownDescription: Label used as `${eventLabel}` when Claude Code finishes a turn.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.subagentStopLabe.markdownDescription: Label used as `${eventLabel}` when a Claude Code subagent (`Task`) finishes. Requires `notifyOnSubagentStop`.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.permissionLabel.markdownDescription: Label used as `${eventLabel}` for permission prompts.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.questionLabel.markdownDescription: Label used as `${eventLabel}` when Claude asks a structured question (`AskUserQuestion`).

claudeCodeSupernotifier.idlePromptLabel.markdownDescription: Label used as `${eventLabel}` for idle prompts.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.attentionLabel.markdownDescription: Fallback label used as `${eventLabel}` for other Notification events when no message is provided.

claudeCodeSupernotifier.statusBar.enable.markdownDescription: Show a Claude Code status bar item that reflects the current session state (`working`, `waiting`, `idle`). Click it to focus the matching Claude Code session. Toggling this setting applies immediately.
